pageSize.description: The number of response actions to return per page.

commands.description: A list of response action command names to filter by.

agentIds.description: A list of Elastic Agent IDs to filter the response actions by.

userIds.description: A list of user IDs that submitted the response actions.

startDate.description: A start date in ISO 8601 format or Date Math format (for example, `now-24h`).

endDate.description: An end date in ISO 8601 format or Date Math format (for example, `now`).

agentTypes.description: The agent type to filter response actions by. Defaults to `endpoint`.

withOutputs.description: A list of response action IDs whose outputs should be included in the response.

types.description: A list of response action types to filter by (`automated`, `manual`).
